method: Built-in image_gen transparent-background extraction from the user's original expansion card reference; generated alpha preserved, no pixel postprocessing.
prompt:
Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one standalone transparent PNG Sprite for a Unity fantasy card's upper-left category icon.
Edit target/reference: the supplied card reference sheet. Extract and faithfully reproduce ONLY the small icon INSIDE the circular gold badge at the upper-left of the LEFT card, beside the Korean title. That icon consists of a small rounded square sandy brown soil tile in the LOWER-LEFT and one thick beveled golden-yellow PLUS sign immediately at its UPPER-RIGHT, with their exact relative positions and scale preserved.
The soil tile has subtle scattered dark pebble speckles, rounded corners and a thin dark contour. The gold plus has a bright top-left highlight, warm amber lower/right bevel, crisp dark contour. Match the original reference icon very closely; upscale cleanly as a production game UI sprite.
Output ONLY that tile-and-plus symbol, centered as a single compact composition on a square transparent canvas with about 8% clear padding on all sides. The plus must be legible when reduced to a 60-pixel UI icon; retain its gap from the tile and do not overlap their silhouettes.
DO NOT include the circular badge's gold rim or its black background, any banner, frame, letters, numbers, Korean text, other terrain shapes, large card illustration, shadow behind a circle, or UI editor handles. This is a distinct small category icon, independent of the large four-cell expansion artwork.
Keep actual alpha transparency everywhere outside the soil tile and gold plus. No checkerboard painted into pixels. No new ornaments or redesign.
scope: Dedicated category symbol (small soil tile + gold plus). Preserve separate dark olive badge frame and large expansion artworks. Centered 70x70 non-raycast Image.
validation: PNG 1254x1254; corner alpha 0, tile/plus alpha 253. Unity Sprite Single / centered pivot / FullRect / Bilinear / alpha transparency / no mipmaps / uncompressed imported. Prefab Diff changes only TypeBadge/TypeIcon Sprite and centered Anchor/Pivot/position, retaining 70x70 size. Separate olive Frame and central Artwork retained. View binding, null/restore icon API, six shape Artwork switches and inherited Canvas_Preparation card checked. Actual Unity uGUI card render visually verified at Tools/Art/Previews/BattleCardRedesign_ExpansionTypeIcon.png. Unity compiled; Console errors/warnings 0. Lobby Scene and unsaved state preserved; no Scene save. Play Mode not rerun for this icon-only change.
